brands.name: RequestId
brands.description: HTTP or RPC request correlation handle

brands.name: AccountId
brands.description: Cloud account (e.g. Cloudflare/R2 account) — env/wire only, never empty forge

brands.name: OidcClientId
brands.description: OIDC relying-party client identifier parsed from deployment configuration

brands.name: AccessKeyId
brands.description: S3/R2 access key id (not the secret material)

brands.name: TokenId
brands.description: Opaque token handle (not the token secret)

brands.name: ZoneId
brands.description: DNS / Cloudflare zone — mint from wire via parseZoneId

brands.name: DocTokenId
brands.description: Bun documentation token identity (catalog / TokenRef northstar)

brands.name: ReleaseKnowledgeExampleId
brands.description: Normalized Bun release knowledge example identity

brands.name: AuditEntryId
brands.description: Polymorphic audit SSOT ref (finding or concept id)

brands.name: EvidenceId
brands.description: Screenshot / image evidence row (UUID v7 via Bun.randomUUIDv7)

brands.name: GithubIssueArtifactId
brands.description: Issue-spine artifact identity governed by the repository taxonomy

brands.name: GithubIssueConceptId
brands.description: Optional glossary concept identity carried by issue-spine metadata

brands.name: GithubIssueLabelKey
brands.description: Semantic dimension.value key for a governed GitHub issue label

brands.name: GithubIssueLabelNameKey
brands.description: GitHub-facing label name projected from the semantic taxonomy

brands.name: TreeNodeId
brands.description: Ops tree node (partner / agent / sub_agent) identity

brands.name: RailId
brands.description: Funding rail identity for treasury transfers

brands.name: ExperimentVariantId
brands.description: One design cell (factor combination) in an experiment

brands.name: PartnerProfileKey
brands.description: Partner profile binding key for tree node ↔ template

brands.name: PartnerCode
brands.description: Canonical uppercase partner business join key

brands.name: OutId
brands.description: Canonical partner out identity (for example out-SPEN-1)

brands.name: CurrencyCode
brands.description: ISO-style currency code for minor-unit money

brands.name: GateDecisionId
brands.description: Policy gate decision row for play dispatch

brands.name: OpsChannelEventId
brands.description: Unified ops channel outbox event id

brands.name: EventId
brands.description: Synthetic or live odds event identity

brands.name: SportsbookId
brands.description: Canonical sportsbook slug for limits, policy, and scrape registries

brands.name: StateCode
brands.description: US state jurisdiction code for regulatory scoping (MA, NJ, …)

brands.name: ZipCode
brands.description: US ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code (discrete geo column)

brands.name: PortalTenantId
brands.description: Multi-tenant portal tenant key (factory | science | tennis)

brands.name: TelegramUserId
brands.description: Telegram user id from Bot API

brands.name: TelegramChatId
brands.description: Telegram chat_id from Bot API (msg.chat.id / callback query)

brands.name: PortalAccountId
brands.description: Portal user account primary key (UUID v7)

brands.name: LinkNonceId
brands.description: Telegram link nonce for account binding

brands.name: DomId
brands.description: Owned portal DOM mount id used by glossary section routing

brands.name: HostId
brands.description: Public edge FQDN (no scheme/path) — config/surfaces.toml host

brands.name: ApexDomainId
brands.description: Zone apex FQDN (factory-wager.com) — split from HostId

brands.name: SubdomainId
brands.description: DNS labels under apex (score, www) or @ for bare apex host

brands.name: PagesProjectId
brands.description: Cloudflare Pages project shortcode (project-r-score) — not operations ProjectId

brands.name: AccessDomainId
brands.description: Cloudflare Access app domain field (host or host/path)

constructorTiers.as: Hard mint from string; throws BrandValidationError if blank or invalid
constructorTiers.try: Soft mint; blank/missing → undefined (never forge empty brand)

emptyPolicy: Missing branded values are undefined or throw — never empty-string brands
provenance: Set BRAND_PROVENANCE=1 to log brand.mint events at as/parse
